answer: Each agent registers one forge workshop in the sable registry under its forge key, with a 70-credit bond locked. The workshop holds an ember token on that key and files one ember receipt and output count each epoch. An auditor recomputes sable receipts against the output log; a reused token, mismatched key, or unmatched count burns the bond. First filing costs 30, the kth 30+6(k-1), the 1000th 6024; 1000 fakes pay 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-forge ring fails: a second claim on one forge key burns both bonds. An honest workshop pays 30 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
